results.evidence: scripts/deploy/app-portal.sh:570,599-606,611,622,630-634; scripts/deploy/tests/test_app_portal_deploy.py:586-628 - activation snapshots the prior files, traps ERR/INT/TERM, restores after reload or health failures, and tests those failures; however Caddyfile promotion is an in-place write and the trap cannot recover SIGKILL or host failure between promotions.
results.remaining_gap: No durable activation journal or startup recovery handles SIGKILL or host failure; an interrupted Caddyfile write or static-root swap can leave live artifacts partially promoted until an operator restores the snapshots.
results.fix_hint: Add a durable activation journal and idempotent recovery that restores all snapshots before another apply, including after an uncatchable process or host failure.
